units.source_text: 龙助在北野甲鱼铺里说的那番激动的话，始终在千重子内心里翻腾。

en.t: The excited words Ryusuke had spoken in the soft-shelled turtle shop in Kitano kept churning in Chieko's heart.

units.source_text: 什么要是千重子还是婴儿的时候被扔到龙助家门前就好了，这句话难道不是相当有分量吗？

en.t: Wasn't there considerable weight in his saying that it would have been better if Chieko had been abandoned in front of Ryusuke's house when she was still a baby?
